description: This file defines an immutable singleton class 'ImmutableHeadersPlaceholder' that implements the 'HeadersPlaceholder' interface. It provides functionality for handling header placeholders in a model, including support checks and resolution of header values from a map.

classes.name: ImmutableHeadersPlaceholder
classes.description: An immutable singleton class providing support for header placeholders, allowing header value retrieval from a map.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix string used for headers, which is 'header'.

methods.name: getSupportedNames
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable empty list, indicating no specific supported names.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks whether the placeholder supports a given name; always returns true.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the header value from the provided headers map for the given header key after validating inputs.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the class.
